title: Brauer groups of smooth loci in linear systems and torsors over Jacobians of plane curves
summary: We study Brauer groups of the smooth loci in linear systems on simply connected smooth projective varieties. Under a suitable ampleness condition, we prove that the Brauer group is at most $\mathbb Z/2 \mathbb Z$. This applies when the underlying variety is the projective plane, a very general K3 surface, or a general cubic fourfold. As an application, we compute the Tate--Shafarevich group parametrizing torsors over the relative Jacobians of universal smooth plane curves. Our approach is via a study of the $2$-nodal locus in the linear system.
